## Wednesday 18 November 2026

### Baglietto Derthona Tortona vs. Riga Zelli (17:30 CET)

##### Mario Fioretti, Derthona head coach

"We will be playing against a team whose style of basketball is built on running, intensity, and rebounding. Our first priority must be to take away easy scoring opportunities, focusing to contain the significant talent of their backcourt players - who initiate a large portion of their offense - within a half-court setting. On the offensive end, we will need to keep things very simple in response to the defensive setups we encounter, as Riga Zelli is a team capable of making tactical adjustments throughout the game."

##### Dominik Olejniczak, Derthona center

"We are aware what is at the stake with the game on Wednesday. It's exciting to play a game at relatively early point of the season that has a lot of weight to it, I know that my teammates and I will be extra motivated. What we learned from the first game in Riga I'll keep to myself and hopefully everyone will be able to see it on Wednesday. The progress for sure has been made; how far are we from where we would like to be as a team it's hard to tell. I hope it will come rather sooner or later obviously, but all we can do is focus on the next game, one game at a time and keep building our identity."

##### Derthona injury report:

All of Coach Fioretti's players are available.

##### Rokas Kondratavicius, Riga Zelli head coach

"Derthona is a very solid EuroCup team and we can see that they are improving their form week by week. With some solid additions to their roster, I think they are a stronger team than when we first played against them. I think the key to secure the victory for us is to look more at ourselves than our opponents, because the last three or four games we are not playing the best basketball we want to play. We need to come back to our foundation, our core values."

##### Kristians Feierbergs, Riga Zelli forward

"It's always a special feeling to play a EuroCup game: the excitement, the anticipation, everything building up to the game. We know what's our goal and we are ready for the challenge. Now it's time to step onto the court, to trust each other, and to give our best effort."

### U-BT Cluj-Napoca vs. Maxima Roma (18:00 CET)

##### Mihai Silvasan, Cluj head coach

"We are trying to take things step by step, day by day. The guys have been practicing really well and are eager to put together a winning streak. We really need that. We have another opportunity to do so tomorrow, and we will fight to make the most of it."

##### Christian Bishop, Cluj center

"I think the win against Perspektiva was really important, both for the team and the fans. It's always good to get a victory at home, and hopefully we can use that result to build momentum ahead of tomorrow's big game. I think this could be the start of a winning streak in both competitions. We need to regain our confidence, play better together, and bring the same intensity and physicality. If we can do that, we can get the win. Maxima Roma are a well-coached team, but so are we. We want to compete hard and show a different side of ourselves compared to the first game because that performance did not reflect who we are. I feel like we still have a lot to prove. We have to take it one game at a time and give everything we have every time we step on the court. Every game has to be treated as our most important one, as if it were our last. If we compete and play with intensity, we can get the wins we need to stay in the competition."

##### Matteo Cotelli, Maxima head coach

"The match against Cluj marks the end of a very demanding stretch of three consecutive away games. We’ll need to make the most of the physical and mental energy we have left to play with a high level of physicality and toughness. Cluj have changed a lot since our first meeting, and we expect to face a very competitive team in an arena that always has an intense atmosphere. Discipline and teamwork will be the keys to staying competitive."
### Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana vs. Recoletas Salud San Pablo Burgos (18:30 CET)

##### Zvezdan Mitrovic, Cedevita Olimpija head coach

"Burgos made a good start to the Spanish league season, but they are currently facing some difficulties and will be somewhat shorthanded due to player absences. They are a very athletic team that plays aggressive defence. It will be important to win the rebounding battle and make the most of the advantages we have at certain positions. Unfortunately, we will still be without one of our key players, Noah Kirkwood, for a while, so we remain short on the wing. Nevertheless, we have already learned to play without certain players. The journey back from Belgrade has also affected our preparations. We returned to Ljubljana on Monday after the game, practised on Tuesday and have one final session before the game. There is little time to prepare, so we will have to adapt quickly."

##### Matthew Hurt, Cedevita Olimpija forward

"Burgos are going through a difficult stretch, so we expect them to come out with a lot of determination and a strong desire to win. We know what it feels like to be on a losing streak. We have to be ready for their energy and physicality and impose our style of play. If we do that, we will put ourselves in a good position. The start of the season did not go the way we wanted, but we have now found a better rhythm in both the ABA League and the EuroCup. It is important to stay confident and take it one game at a time. We still have plenty of room to improve, and we are not yet the finished product. We have to work hard every day, improve our game and grow together as a team. With every win, the atmosphere in the locker room gets better and the team becomes more united. We will need to focus on every possession and compete for each one. If we can do that, we will give ourselves a good chance of winning."

##### Porfi Fisac, Burgos head coach

"Cedevita has won a lot since getting injured players back. On the other hand, my team continues to become better and more solid as a team."

##### Dusan Radosavljevic, Burgos forward

"We know that Cedevita is a really good team. It's always difficult to play against them, especially on their home court. We won the first game against them, but this will definitely be a different game because both teams have different rosters compared to the first matchup. After a tough game against Breogan \[in the Spanish League\], we need to recover well, stay focused, and bring the same energy and intensity that we showed in our last game. Our goal is to play as well as possible for all 40 minutes and try to get the win. It's going to be a demanding game with a lot of running, but I think and I hope we are ready for that."

### NINERS Chemnitz vs. Tofas Bursa (19:00 CET)

##### Jovan Gorec, Tofas assistant coach

"It's a very important moment for us. Right now we are dealing with some injuries, but I think the team has reacted very well. We showed character and this will help us build more. We are facing an excellent team in Chemnitz, which is very well coached and has a good home-court advantage. It's difficult to play at this arena. They are coming off a big win in the domestic championship, so we need to be ready to compete for 40 minutes and head into the game with the right mentality."

##### Terrell Carter, Tofas center

"This is a good test for us. We've been building some good momentum leading into this game. I think this is the next test for us to see if we can take that next step as a team. Chemnitz is a really good team, really organized. We want to make sure we get this away win, take care of business, and move on to the next one."

### Buducnost VOLI Podgorica vs. Slask Wroclaw (19:00 CET)

##### Andrej Zakelj, Buducnost head coach

"As with our previous EuroCup game, this one is also very important for us. We are playing in front of our home fans. First and foremost, we have to fight, dive for every loose ball, play defense, be aggressive and commit fouls when necessary. The basics are the most important things in games like this. Tactics come after that. I think Slask looks better than they did at the start of the season. They made one change to their roster and brought in a new player, so they certainly have their own ambitions coming into this game. We expect a tough matchup. Their point guard, Hickey, is playing very well, and they also have Robinson at the power forward position. It will certainly be a tough game that requires a lot of energy and focus."

##### Juwan Morgan, Buducnost forward

"I expect a tough and closely contested game. We have to fix a lot of the things we didn't do well against Igokea on the road. That was also a very demanding game, but we have to move forward, keep improving and get better. That's exactly what we've been working on in practice over the last few days, and we have to keep doing that. I expect a fast-paced game. We know they have a lot of talented players who can score one-on-one, as well as some great shooters at the guard positions and at the three. I think we have to be fully focused on defense and try to score in transition after getting stops."

### Aris Thessaloniki vs. Le Mans Sarthe Basket (19:00 CET)

##### Vassilis Spanoulis, Aris head coach

"We are eight rounds into the competition now, around a month and a half has passed. That was the first game of the season, the opening game. This will be a completely different matchup. They are a very good and athletic team. They have had the same coach for years and play with a distinctive style. They put a lot of emphasis on offensive rebounding, and their players take a lot of three-point shots. They are a well-coached team, and once again, we have to play our game and stick to our principles."

##### Neno Dimitrijevic, Aris guard

"We are are a team built to compete against anybody. We have great scorers and great athletes. When we push the tempo and play at our own pace, we can be a dangerous team for everyone. We had a very tough game against Le Mans in France. I think they are in even better shape now than they were when we faced them in France. We know we are going to face a big challenge, but we are ready for it."

##### Guillaume Vizade, Le Mans head coach

"Playing against Aris, in their arena, will be another valuable experience for the team. They are currently one of the best teams in Europe, having just beaten Olympiacos and Panathinaikos at home. It will be a great challenge for us to rise to the level of competition they will impose on us."

##### Carlos Stewart, Le Mans guard

"We are approaching Wednesday's game with the same mindset we bring to every game: staying focused, preparing the right way, and being ready to compete. We know what's at stake. My focus is on helping the team in whatever way I can to put us in the best position to win."
### BOSNA BH Telecom Sarajevo vs. Lietkabelis Panevezys (19:30 CET)

##### Dario Gjergja, BOSNA head coach

"This is an important game for both teams. They have not been at their best in their last two games either. We have to play at a high level for the entire game. They are a team with EuroCup experience and a coach who has been doing an excellent job at the club for years, so we have full respect for them. I hope our fans will help us in this game as well, just like they did on Sunday against Mega."

##### Gary Browne, BOSNA guard

"We know it will be a tough game against Lietkabelis. We need to play together, stay focused, and give our best to get the win."

### Cosea JL Bourg-en-Bresse vs. Napoli Basketball (19:30 CET)

##### Frederic Fauthoux, Bourg head coach

"Napoli are a very strong team coming to Ekinox. If we want to win, we’ll have to play an almost perfect game. We haven’t managed to do that yet this season, and we can see the difficulties we’ve had since the start. It’s up to us to play with more freedom, put together a very good performance and go after this win. After that, we’ll see what we can aim for moving forward. Napoli have one of the best offenses in the EuroCup and are playing with a lot of confidence. They’re in a very good rhythm at the moment. On our side, we need to stay focused on ourselves and find that spark that can bring us confidence and wins. We have to keep believing in ourselves."

##### Adrian Nelson, Bourg forward

"Tomorrow will be a tough but important game. We know they will come hungry to stay on undefeated in Group C so we will need to match their aggression and play together, offensively and defensively, for 40 minutes."

### Skyliners Frankfurt vs. Umana Reyer Venice (19:30 CET)

##### Klaus Perwas, Skyliners head coach

"Venice are an extremely physical and experienced top European team, and they showed us our limits in the second half of the first meeting. If we want to compete against a team like this for 40 minutes, we need to match their intensity from the very first second, take better care of the ball and play as one unit. We need to get back to the basics, execute them consistently and show what true SKYLINERS basketball is all about."

##### Radii Caisin, Skyliners forward

"After our recent games, we definitely want to get the win against Venice. We need to address our mistakes, analyze them and learn from them, even though we don't have much time to do so. The most important thing is that we play as a team."

##### Skyliners injury report

Ivan Crnjac is questionable.

##### Neven Spahija, Reyer head coach

"Their recent results are not at the level they expected, but this game is a trap. For sure, we are going there focused and prepared to play a serious game for all 40 minutes. Frankfurt is a team that runs a lot, scores many points in transition, and works very hard on defense. As I said before, they have lost several games, but for us that means nothing: we want to keep playing at the level we showed in our last game and win. That is our goal."

##### Enoch Boakye, Reyer center

"Right now, we’ve done a good job of bouncing back and staying even-keeled. We went through a couple of tough games, but we’ve always stayed together. The next game is a great opportunity to stay focused, build on what we’ve done so far to gain momentum, and try to keep our winning streak going. Frankfurt is a really good team; they know how to play basketball. We have more size and talent, but at the end of the day, if you don’t take care of your business on the court, you can have all the talent in the world and still lose. So we need to step onto the court locked in and focused, taking advantage of every edge we have. How am I feeling? I feel good, and I’m really happy that Jabari \[Rice\] is back with us.
### Dolomiti Energia Trento vs. Neptunas Klaipeda (20:00 CET)

##### Fabio Bongi, Trento assistant coach

"We certainly need to build on the positive aspects of our recent performances. We are going through a period in which things are not coming as easily as they did at the beginning of the season. We knew this phase would come: we are a team that still needs to grow and gain experience, especially considering the number of new players in the group. We need to be patient. Of course, we need to win games, because that is our goal. However, we must be careful not to let the negative energy generated by defeats turn into stress. Instead, we need to channel that energy into something positive and use it to perform better, starting with our next game. We are facing an opponent we already beat in the first leg, but some time has passed since then and both teams were in a different situation. Neptunas were also still building their team, whereas now they are playing some good basketball. In their last league game, they lost by just a few points on the road against Zalgiris, a EuroLeague team. They have plenty of potential and a clear identity in the way they play. It will be another interesting test. We are absolutely determined to get back to winning ways. I believe the effort the players and everyone in the group are putting in deserves to be rewarded with these two points and a win that we have been missing for a little too long."

##### Darius Brown, Trento guard

"We want to start the second half of the EuroCup season the right way. We already know the team we are going to face, and our goal is to take the court with energy, play our style of basketball and regain consistency. This is a fresh start. We now know all our opponents, and this is the time to bounce back, get back to playing according to our strengths and find the right rhythm heading into the final part of the competition. We managed to beat them in the first leg, but several weeks have passed since then and this will be a different game. We know their players and how they like to play, so we will try to use that knowledge to our advantage, with the aim of getting another win."

##### Trento injury report

Patrick Hassan and Jose Medina Bouza are both ruled out.

### Kids&Us Manresa vs. PAOK Thessaloniki (20:30 CET)

##### Andrea Trinchieri, PAOK head coach

"The standings tells everything you need to know about Wednesday's game. Manresa is a very good team. They have won some big games and have an excellent record in BKT EuroCup. They play well-organised basketball, are in a very good run of form, have a 13-player rotation and are coming off two consecutive wins in the ACB. This is an away game against a team that forces its opponents into a lot of mistakes, and it is an important game for us. We are doing the right things in our games, but when you have a shorter rotation, every game takes a greater toll. Your legs are always heavier and you have less energy. The only thing that matters if we win is that we will have beaten twice a team with the same ambitions as ours for the top positions in the group. Nothing else. Nothing makes your game easier if you don't play well. It will certainly be a difficult game, but simply saying that doesn't change anything. We have to do what needs to be done, try to be smart, find different ways to generate energy and make sure we are fresh. That is also part of my job: finding ways to get the team performing."

##### Nikos Chougkaz, PAOK forward

"It’s going to be a tough game in Spain against a team that plays a different style of basketball, so we’ll have to adjust quickly. I believe we have the ability and the talent to adapt to any situation. We’ve faced teams that like to play at a fast pace and others that prefer a slower game, and I’m confident we have the quality and talent to raise our level and play better."
## Tuesday 17 November 2026

### Turk Telekom Ankara vs. La Laguna Tenerife (17:30 CET)

##### Tim Abromaitis, Tenerife center

"We arrive at this game after a long journey, but we are going to fight for the win, because we know how important every game is at this stage of the EuroCup. We expect a difficult match; Turk Telekom Ankara is a very talented team. We know we need to set our own pace. We will need a well-rounded performance across all positions, fighting for every rebound, playing our own game, and avoiding too many turnovers. It won’t be easy, as they are a good team, but we are confident in our chances and we are going to fight."

### Balkan Botevgrad vs. ratiopharm ulm (18:00 CET)

##### Ty Harrelson, Ulm head coach

"It's important for us that we manage to win away in the EuroCup. Recently we played better and now we have some players available again. For the standings situation, every win is important to secure a playoff spot in the EuroCup."

### Roma Basketball vs. Bahcesehir College Istanbul (20:00 CET)

##### Alessandro Magro, Roma head coach

"We will begin the second half of the regular season against one of the best teams in Europe. They are currently leading our EuroCup group and sit at the top of the Turkish league standings. They have very talented guards, good-sized bigs, and plenty of experience at the European level. It will be a tough game, but it will also give us the opportunity to react after our last home defeat in Serie A."

##### Kelly Olynyk, Roma forward

"It will be a tough game against a really good team. We need to come out ready to play our style of basketball for the full 40 minutes. It's always great to play in front of our fans. They were fantastic in our last game. Unfortunately, we came up a little bit short, but we're getting better and better, and I'm confident things will turn around."

##### Roma injury report:

Gerald Ayayi is sidelined with an ankle injury.
### Rostock Seawolves vs. Hapoel Midtown Jerusalem (20:00 CET)

##### Przemyslaw Frasunkiewicz, Rostock head coach

"Jerusalem is still unbeaten, both in the domestic league and in the BKT EuroCup. We have no pressure - and you never know how a game will go."

##### Bent Leuchten, Rostock center

"We're going into the game against Jerusalem as underdogs. It's something special to be able to compete against such a strong team with Rostock. We'll give everything to give the fans a great basketball night."

##### Sasa Obradovic, Jerusalem head coach

"Rostock is really unpredictable. They've shown so many different faces. You don't really know which face you're going to meet. For us, after our big win, it's very important to stay grounded. It's very important to understand that every team wants to beat us even more than before because we haven't lost yet. To maintain our perfect record, we really need to respect our opponent and ourselves, without overrespecting or being arrogant going into this game."

##### Shake Milton, Jerusalem guard

"Rostock is a good team. They're very talented. They have guards who can create. So for us, we have to be locked into our game plan, make sure we're solid on defense, and then offensively share the ball and we'll be in a good spot."

##### Jerusalem injury report: 

Jared Harper is unavailable due to a thumb injury.

### London Lions vs. Siauliai Basketball (20:30 CET)

##### Tautvydas Sabonis, London Lions head coach

"We’ve got to be disciplined. They are an offensive-minded team. They’ve got a lot of 3pt shooters, a lot of flare screens, back screens. You know, we’ve got to be prepared to be mentally tough and not relax at any moment of the game, especially defensively."

##### Joel Scott, London Lions forward

"We were prideful in what we did \[against Reyer in Round 7\]. We came out ready to play. We knew we were down a little bit with some people out, and we just fought, and that's really all it is. And I think that's going to be the case again tomorrow night. We are going to have to fight and be ready to go."

#### Darius Songaila, Siauliai head coach

"Like always on the road, it's going to be a tough game. We'll have to stick to the game plan and what we've agreed on, and hope we get a chance to fight for the win at the end. I've played here before, back when I represented Zalgiris, and I've watched their other games against Lithuanian teams, so I have no doubt the atmosphere will be great. Our goal is to enjoy it."

#### Selim Fofana, Siauliai guard

"We have to play well on defense and try to stop their transition game. If we play together as a team, we'll have a chance to win."
